MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Ron Sinclair.
Aristotle Evia, Esq. for Plaintiff: Treadwell & Rollo, Inc.
Plaintiff's Witness: John Gouchon, was sworn and direct examined.
After hearing the testimony and evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendant: Club Renaissance Partners, LLC. as follows:
Principal $25,612.51
Prejudgment Interest $456.11
Attorney's Fees $3,915.70
Costs $380.00, for a total of $30,364.32
Judgment signed in open court.
